principle_violations.reason: The Circle and Square classes do not support volume calculation, but they implement the volume method, which throws an exception. This violates the Liskov Substitution Principle, as substituting a shape expecting volume calculation will lead to runtime exceptions.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the design so that Shape implementations that cannot calculate volume do not need to implement a volume method.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
